title.zh: 選題與可行性
title.en: Use case selection and feasibility

summary.zh: 確認業務價值、資料準備度和負責人，估算整合、人工審查與維護的總成本。
summary.en: Compare value, data readiness, integration and costs before choosing work to try.

title.zh: 流程與分工
title.en: Workflow and responsibilities

summary.zh: 決定人機分工、交接方式，以及需要哪些工具和資料。
summary.en: Define tasks, handoffs, tools and human responsibilities.

title.zh: 試行與交付
title.en: Pilots and delivery

summary.zh: 試行前先記錄現有表現，訂好試行範圍、交付成果和停止條件。
summary.en: Plan a small trial with a baseline, clear deliverables and stopping conditions.

title.zh: 驗證與衡量
title.en: Validation and measurement

summary.zh: 驗收成果，和原本的品質、工時及返工量比較，再核對實際總成本。
summary.en: Check acceptance, quality, time, rework and cost.

title.zh: 營運與演進
title.en: Operations and evolution

summary.zh: 安排培訓、維護和擴大使用，並規劃流程調整與工具替換。
summary.en: Plan everyday support, handover, expansion and changes.

title.zh: 治理與管理
title.en: Governance and management

summary.zh: 訂清資料使用與權限、法規和合約要求，以及事件應變與對外責任。
summary.en: Define data access, approvals, accountability and incident response throughout adoption.

title.zh: 哪些工作值得先用 AI？
title.en: Which work should we try AI on first?

summary.zh: 從工作頻率、業務價值、成果能否驗收，以及出錯的影響來比較場景。
summary.en: Compare frequency, business value, how results can be checked, and the consequences of errors.

title.zh: 現有的資料和知識夠用嗎？
title.en: Do we have enough usable data and knowledge?

summary.zh: 盤點資料是否找得到、能否取得，以及有哪些關鍵知識只掌握在少數人手上。
summary.en: Check what can be found and accessed, and which knowledge is held by only a few people.

title.zh: 既有系統接得上嗎？有哪些技術限制？
title.en: Can AI connect to our existing systems? What are the technical limits?

summary.zh: 確認資料能否讀取和回寫，以及舊系統、權限或介面可能造成的限制。
summary.en: Check how data can be read and written, and identify constraints in legacy systems, permissions and interfaces.

title.zh: 導入、人工審查和長期維護，總共要花多少錢？
title.en: What will setup, human review and ongoing maintenance cost?

summary.zh: 試行前把工具、整合、培訓、審查和維護都列入成本估算。
summary.en: Estimate tools, integration, staff training, review and maintenance before the pilot.

title.zh: 該買現成產品、組合既有工具，還是自己開發？
title.en: Should we buy a product, combine existing tools or build our own?

summary.zh: 用同一個工作情境比較上手時間、成本、控制程度與未來換工具的難度。
summary.en: Compare time to use, cost, control and ease of switching using the same workflow.

title.zh: 誰出資、誰對成果負責？相關團隊有共識嗎？
title.en: Who funds the work and owns the results? Are the teams aligned?

summary.zh: 確認預算、成果和後續維護各由誰負責，以及哪些團隊需要一起決定。
summary.en: Name the owners of budget, outcomes and ongoing maintenance, and identify who needs to agree.

title.zh: 這份工作怎麼拆？人和 AI 各負責哪一段？
title.en: How should we divide the work between people and AI?

summary.zh: 把工作拆成可交接的步驟，標出執行、判斷和驗收各由誰負責。
summary.en: Break work into steps with clear handoffs and owners for execution, judgment and acceptance.

title.zh: 哪些工作可以讓 AI 自己完成？何時要交回人處理？
title.en: What can AI complete on its own, and when should a person take over?

summary.zh: 界定 AI 能獨立完成的任務，以及遇到資訊不足、超出範圍或失敗時如何交接。
summary.en: Define independent tasks and handoffs when information is missing, scope is exceeded or execution fails.

title.zh: 怎麼把任務、限制和交付要求說清楚？
title.en: How do we explain the task, constraints and required deliverables?

summary.zh: 寫明任務的輸入、限制、預期成果和可檢查的驗收例子。
summary.en: Specify inputs, limits, expected outputs and examples that can be used for acceptance.

title.zh: 需要哪些 AI 角色、技能和工具？
title.en: Which AI roles, skills and tools do we need?

summary.zh: 依各個工作步驟找出需要的能力，再選擇合適的 agents、skills 和 tools。
summary.en: Identify the capabilities each step requires before choosing agents, skills and tools.

title.zh: 怎麼整理工作知識，讓 AI 用到正確的資料，並把結果送回既有系統？
title.en: How do we give AI the right knowledge and send results back to our systems?

summary.zh: 決定哪些資料可作為依據、由誰更新，以及結果如何回寫和處理失敗。
summary.en: Define approved knowledge sources, who updates them, and how results and write failures are handled.

title.zh: 多個 AI 一起做事時，怎麼分工、共享資訊和交接？
title.en: How should multiple AI agents divide work, share information and hand off results?

summary.zh: 釐清每個角色讀取與交付的內容，以及誰負責處理彼此的衝突。
summary.en: Specify each role's inputs and outputs, and who resolves conflicts between results.

title.zh: 第一輪要試哪一段工作？範圍多大才看得出效果？
title.en: Which part of the work should the first pilot cover, and how large should it be?

summary.zh: 選定一類代表性工作、一組參與者和一段試行期間。
summary.en: Choose a representative type of work, a set of participants and a pilot period.

title.zh: 試行前要記錄哪些基線、訂哪些成功條件？
title.en: What baseline and success criteria should we record before a pilot?

summary.zh: 先記錄現有品質、工時、錯誤和返工，再定義什麼結果值得繼續。
summary.en: Record existing quality, time, errors and rework, then agree what results would justify continuing.

title.zh: 試行成果怎麼交付、審查並接回原有流程？
title.en: How should pilot outputs be delivered, reviewed and added to the existing workflow?

summary.zh: 說清成果格式、所需佐證、審查責任及審查未通過時如何退回。
summary.en: Specify output format, supporting evidence, review responsibility and how rejected work is returned.

title.zh: 遇到什麼情況要停止試行，退回原本的做法？
title.en: When should we stop a pilot and return to the previous workflow?

summary.zh: 先約定停止條件、誰有權停止，以及怎麼恢復原有工作。
summary.en: Agree stopping criteria, who can stop the pilot and how normal work will resume.

title.zh: 怎麼讓參與試行的員工知道要做什麼、去哪裡回報問題？
title.en: How will pilot participants know what to do and where to report problems?

summary.zh: 說清試行期間工作會怎麼變、誰能提供協助、回報後由誰處理。
summary.en: Explain changes to the work, available help and who handles reported problems.

title.zh: 怎麼驗收 AI 的成果？什麼算通過？
title.en: How do we check AI outputs, and what counts as a pass?

summary.zh: 訂出可判定的通過條件，用代表性案例檢查實際交付的結果。
summary.en: Set clear acceptance criteria and test actual deliverables with representative cases.

title.zh: 怎麼抓出看起來正確、其實有錯的結果？
title.en: How do we catch results that look correct but contain errors?

summary.zh: 查證關鍵來源、重算重要數字，並測試容易被表面答案掩蓋的錯誤。
summary.en: Check key sources, recalculate important numbers and test for errors hidden by convincing answers.

title.zh: 誰來驗收？什麼時候需要獨立覆核？
title.en: Who accepts the results, and when is independent review needed?

summary.zh: 依成果出錯的影響決定誰驗收，以及何時需要由另一位合格的人覆核。
summary.en: Use the consequences of an error to decide who reviews the work and when another qualified person should check it.

title.zh: 和原本的做法相比，品質、工時和返工有沒有改善？
title.en: Has quality, time or rework improved compared with our previous process?

summary.zh: 和試行前的同類工作比較，把人工審查和修正時間也算進去。
summary.en: Compare similar work with the baseline and include the time spent reviewing and correcting outputs.

title.zh: 每件通過驗收的工作用了多少 token、花了多少錢？換一種做法會更有效率嗎？
title.en: How many tokens and how much money does each accepted result cost? Could another approach be more efficient?

summary.zh: 在相同驗收標準下，比較每件合格成果的 token 和費用，把失敗與重試也算進去。
summary.en: Compare tokens and costs per accepted result under the same acceptance criteria, including failures and retries.

title.zh: 試行成功後，怎麼變成團隊的日常工作？
title.en: How do we turn a successful pilot into the team's everyday work?

summary.zh: 把已驗證的做法接入團隊例行流程，指定負責人、支援管道和回顧時間。
summary.en: Add the verified approach to routine work, name an owner and support channel, and schedule reviews.

title.zh: 誰負責維護、培訓和交接？關鍵人員離開時，誰能接手？
title.en: Who maintains the workflow, trains people and handles handover? Who can take over if a key person leaves?

summary.zh: 把流程寫成可交接的操作說明，並讓備援人員實際走一次。
summary.en: Document the operating steps and have a backup owner actually work through them.

title.zh: 員工不願意用，或用了以後不再檢查，該怎麼處理？
title.en: What if staff do not want to use AI, or stop checking its results?

summary.zh: 找出採用障礙，並確認必要的人工判斷和抽查仍然有效。
summary.en: Find the barriers to adoption and check whether required human judgment and spot checks still work.

title.zh: 怎麼監控日常 token 用量和費用，發現異常時誰來查？
title.en: How do we monitor daily token usage and costs, and who investigates anomalies?

summary.zh: 按流程追蹤用量與費用，分辨是工作量增加、單件變貴，還是反覆重試。
summary.en: Track usage and cost by workflow to distinguish more work from higher cost per task or repeated retries.

title.zh: 什麼時候該擴大使用？換一個團隊前要重驗哪些條件？
title.en: When should we expand use, and what must we retest for a new team?

summary.zh: 確認新團隊的資料、工作量、審查能力和適用情境，再分批擴大。
summary.en: Check the next team's data, workload, review capacity and use cases before expanding in stages.

title.zh: AI 能力或工具變了，什麼時候該重新設計流程？
title.en: When should changes in AI capabilities or tools lead us to redesign the workflow?

summary.zh: 用原有案例和基準重驗，判斷新的能力是否值得改變人機分工。
summary.en: Retest existing cases and baselines to decide whether new capabilities justify changing responsibilities.

title.zh: 供應商漲價、停服或改條款時，怎麼切換工具或退回原本的做法？
title.en: How do we switch tools or restore the previous process if a supplier raises prices, stops service or changes terms?

summary.zh: 先確認資料能否匯出、替代工具能否接手，以及切換期間如何維持工作。
summary.en: Check data export, replacement tools and how work will continue during the transition.

title.zh: AI 可以讀取哪些資料、執行哪些操作？誰能授權？
title.en: What data may AI read and what actions may it take? Who can authorize access?

summary.zh: 分開定義可讀、可寫與可執行的範圍，並指定各項權限的授權人。
summary.en: Define separate read, write and execution permissions, with an authorizer for each.

title.zh: 哪些 AI 操作或決定要先由人核准？誰能核准政策例外？
title.en: Which AI actions or decisions need human approval, and who can approve policy exceptions?

summary.zh: 依影響程度設核准點，為例外指定負責人、理由和期限。
summary.en: Set approval points according to impact and record the owner, reason and expiry for exceptions.

title.zh: 員工已經在用未經核准的 AI 工具，該怎麼納入管理？
title.en: How do we manage AI tools that staff are already using without approval?

summary.zh: 先掌握實際用途與資料流向，再安排審查、核准或替代做法。
summary.en: Understand actual uses and data flows, then arrange review, approval or a suitable alternative.

title.zh: 使用客戶資料或 AI 產出時，要確認哪些法規、合約和智慧財產要求？
title.en: What legal, contractual and intellectual property requirements apply to customer data and AI outputs?

summary.zh: 整理資料來源、使用目的與工具條款，交由相關負責人確認限制。
summary.en: Document sources, intended use and tool terms so responsible specialists can check the restrictions.

title.zh: 出事時誰能暫停、復原和通知受影響的人？誰對外負責？
title.en: Who can pause AI, restore work and notify affected people? Who is accountable externally?

summary.zh: 分配停用、復原、通知與對外說明的責任，並用情境演練確認交接。
summary.en: Assign responsibility for shutdown, recovery, notifications and external communication, then rehearse handoffs.

title.zh: 哪些變化會觸發重新審查權限、風險和管理規則？
title.en: What changes should trigger another review of permissions, risks and management rules?

summary.zh: 在模型、資料、操作權限或使用情境改變時，指定誰重新檢查哪些條件。
summary.en: Assign who rechecks which conditions when models, data, permissions or use cases change.
